entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...It's quiet in here. Almost eerily so.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, we're in a Palace. That ain't[n]anything to be freakin' out over.
entries.uk: Та ну, ми ж у Палаці. Нема[n]чого через таке панікувати.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, the Palace reflects its[n]ruler's heart... We may want[n]to check these paintings out.
entries.uk: Гм, Палац відображає серце[n]свого володаря... Мабуть, варто[n]оглянути ці картини.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on a second, Joker.[n]Let's take a look at the paintings first.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh hey, there's some kinda[n]explanation here... Lemme see...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...It's someone's name and age?[n]What the hell?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That can't be the title of the[n]painting... right? Do you think[n]it's the artist's name?
entries.uk: Це ж не може бути назва[n]картини... так? Думаєш,[n]це ім'я художника?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's check the other paintings too.[n]I think there might be something[n]important about them...
entries.uk: Огляньмо й інші картини.[n]Здається, у них може бути[n]щось важливе...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: These are [clr 2]infrared lasers[clr 27]. They're[n]a pretty common security measure.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we trip one, the enemy will[n]know exactly where we are.
entries.uk: Якщо зачепимо хоч один, ворог[n]точно знатиме, де ми.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Make sure you slip between the[n]lasers so as not to trigger them.
entries.uk: Прослизай між лазерами так,[n]щоб їх не зачепити.
